# Personal method contract

<!-- bp-vault-skills:start -->
- Capture maps to an `Inbox/` note. Intent uses prose, not a property.
- Durable knowledge maps to an `Ideas/` note developed in the author's words.
- Practice maps to an attempted experiment or rehearsal described in the related note.
- Application maps to an action or small project under `Projects/`.
- Evidence records errors, changed behavior, outcomes, and new connections in the related review.
- Developed is a conceptual state only. Learned requires unaided retrieval plus transfer and has no property mapping.
- Source hierarchy: direct evidence and named external sources outrank memory. Mark personal experience and interpretation explicitly. Show conflicts.
- Daily checks the current attempt. Weekly compares attempts and recurring friction. Monthly looks for durable change and applications that held up.
- Review outcomes belong in `Reviews/`; record a review condition, never schedule it.
<!-- bp-vault-skills:end -->
